headline: Molina Healthcare (MOH) Plans Big 2027 ACA Pullback After Profit Pressure
summary: Molina Healthcare (NYSE:MOH) plans to significantly scale back its Affordable Care Act business from 2027. The company intends to limit ACA operations to six states and reduce premiums by a meaningful margin. The move follows ongoing pressure on ACA profitability, including falling membership and higher medical costs. Molina Healthcare, trading at $197.55, is restructuring its portfolio as it responds to challenges in the ACA segment. The stock is up 10.7% year to date and 19.7% over the...
